## Comprehensive Web UI Component Analysis

Based on my thorough exploration of the `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui` codebase, here's a detailed breakdown of the task detail views and their differences:

---

## 1. KANBAN BOARD DETAIL: TaskDetailModal

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/board/TaskDetailModal.svelte`

**Purpose:** Modal dialog for viewing and acting on task details from the Kanban board view.

**Container:** Dialog (modal overlay) - `Dialog.Root` with max-width of 2xl and max-height of 85vh with overflow scroll

**Data Type:** `TaskDetail` (full detail with notes and todos)

**Displayed Content:**
- Task title + slug (in Dialog.Header)
- Description (if present)
- Status badge (with color styling from `getStatusClasses()`)
- Priority badge ("Priority N")
- Task type badge
- Automation status badge (if present)
- Spec reference link (with ReferenceLink component)
- Tags (wrapped in badges)
- Dependencies list (with ReferenceLink components for each dep)
- Blocked By section (with ReferenceLinks)
- VCS references (branch/PR with external links)
- Plan reference (or Derivation text)
- Session reference link
- **Todos section** with visual completion indicators (✅/⏸️)
- **Notes section** with:
  - Add Note textarea (with Submit button) - only if not in static mode
  - Notes list showing author, timestamp, and content for each note

**Action Buttons:** (only if not in static mode)
- **Start** - if status === 'pending'
- **Submit for Review** - if status === 'in_progress' or 'needs_work'
- **Complete** - if status === 'in_progress' or 'pending_review' (shows reason input form on toggle)
- **Block** - if status !== blocked/completed/cancelled (shows reason input form on toggle)
- **Add Note** - always visible (in notes section)

**Key Behaviors:**
- Loads task data on mount via `fetchTask()`
- Reloads task after any action via `reloadAndNotify()`
- Manages modal state with `open` and `taskRef` bindable props
- Handles read-only mode with `isStaticMode()` check
- Shows loading skeleton while fetching
- Has error handling with action error display

**Component Nesting Structure:**
```
TaskDetailModal (Dialog)
├── Dialog.Header
│   ├── Dialog.Title
│   └── Dialog.Description
└── Dialog.Content
    ├── Description (p tag)
    ├── Status/Priority/Type/Automation badges
    ├── Spec ref section (ReferenceLink)
    ├── Tags section
    ├── Dependencies section (ReferenceLinks)
    ├── Blocked By section (ReferenceLinks)
    ├── VCS section (external links)
    ├── Plan/Session/Derivation sections (ReferenceLink)
    ├── Separator
    ├── Actions row (buttons with reason input forms)
    ├── Separator
    ├── Todos section
    ├── Separator
    └── Notes section
        ├── Add Note form (Textarea + Button)
        └── Notes list (note items with metadata)
```

---

## 2. TASK LIST DETAIL: Inline Right Panel

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/routes/tasks/+page.svelte` (lines 335-544)

**Purpose:** Fixed right-side panel that slides in when a task is selected from the list.

**Container:** Fixed position overlay div (`inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-3/4 max-w-lg`) - custom panel implementation (not using Dialog or Sheet component)

**Data Type:** `TaskDetail` (full detail with notes and todos)

**Displayed Content:**
- Task title (in header section)
- Status badge + Priority badge + Type badge (if not 'task')
- Description (optional - no description field shown)
- Spec reference link (navigates to `/specs?ref=...`)
- Tags (if any)
- Dependencies section (with links to `/tasks?ref=...`)
- Blocked By section (raw text list, no links)
- **Todos section** with visual indicators (✅/⏸️)
- **Notes section** with:
  - Add Note textarea (with Submit button) - only if not in static mode
  - Notes list with author, timestamp, and content for each note

**Action Buttons:** (only if not in static mode)
- **Start Task** - if status === 'pending' (disabled with tooltip in static mode)
- **Add Note** - always visible (in notes section, disabled in static mode)

**Key Behaviors:**
- Panel opens as fixed overlay when task selected from list or URL has `?ref=` param
- Loads task data via `fetchTask()` on selection
- Manages panel state with `panel` object containing `open` and `task` properties
- Handles escape key to close
- Handles overlay click outside to close
- Reloads task after actions via `fetchTask()`
- Reloads full task list after actions via `loadTasks()`
- Watches for WebSocket updates and reloads selected task if it changed
- Shows highlight animation on updated tasks (via `updatedTaskIds` set)

**Component Nesting Structure:**
```
Fixed Overlay Div
└── Panel Div (fixed right-side)
    ├── Header section
    │   ├── Task title (h2)
    │   └── Close button (XIcon)
    ├── Content section
    │   ├── Status/Priority/Type badges
    │   ├── Spec ref section (with hardcoded href construction)
    │   ├── Tags section
    │   ├── Dependencies section (with hardcoded href links)
    │   ├── Blocked By section (text list)
    │   ├── Separator
    │   ├── Start Task button (with tooltip in static mode)
    │   ├── Separator
    │   ├── Todos section
    │   ├── Separator
    │   └── Notes section
    │       ├── Add Note form (Textarea + Button)
    │       └── Notes list (note items with metadata)
```

---

## 3. SPEC ITEM DETAIL: ItemDetail Sheet Panel

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/ItemDetail.svelte`

**Purpose:** Shared component for viewing spec item details (used on Specs page).

**Container:** Sheet (slide-out panel from right) - `SheetContent` with `sm:max-w-2xl overflow-y-auto`

**Data Type:** `ItemDetail` (includes acceptance criteria and traits) + linked `TaskSummary[]`

**Displayed Content:**
- Spec type badge + Title (in SheetHeader)
- Description (if present, in SheetDescription)
- Tags (if any)
- **Acceptance Criteria** section:
  - Accordion with expandable items
  - Each AC shows: "AC-N: {given}"
  - Full GWT format on expansion (Given/When/Then)
  - Test coverage indicator (Covered/Not covered/Unknown) with icon
- **Traits** section (with ReferenceLink components for navigation)
- **Implementation** section:
  - Lists linked tasks with:
    - Status badge
    - Task title
    - Notes count badge
  - Each task is a clickable link to `/tasks?ref=...`
  - "No tasks linked to this spec item yet" if empty

**Action Buttons:** None - read-only detail view

**Key Behaviors:**
- Loads spec item data via `fetchItem()` on mount
- Loads linked tasks via `fetchItemTasks()` concurrently
- Manages panel state with `open` and `ref` bindable props
- Has error handling
- Shows loading skeleton while fetching

**Component Nesting Structure:**
```
ItemDetail (Sheet)
└── SheetContent
    └── SheetHeader + SheetDescription
    ├── Tags section
    ├── Acceptance Criteria section
    │   └── Accordion
    │       └── AccordionItems
    │           ├── AC summary (GWT first line)
    │           └── Full GWT + test coverage on expand
    ├── Traits section (ReferenceLinks)
    └── Implementation section
        └── Linked tasks list (clickable links)
```

---

## 4. COMPONENT HIERARCHY & STRUCTURE

### Top-Level Pages:
1. **`/routes/tasks/board/+page.svelte`** - Kanban board view
   - Uses: `TaskDetailModal` for detail view
   - Layout: Board columns + modal overlay
   
2. **`/routes/tasks/+page.svelte`** - Task list view
   - Uses: Inline custom detail panel (not a reusable component)
   - Layout: List + fixed right panel
   
3. **`/routes/specs/+page.svelte`** - Spec tree view
   - Uses: `ItemDetail` (Sheet) component
   - Layout: Tree + right panel

### Board-Specific Components:
- `/lib/components/board/TaskDetailModal.svelte` - Modal detail view
- `/lib/components/board/TaskCard.svelte` - Individual task card (Kanban)
- `/lib/components/board/BoardColumn.svelte` - Column container
- `/lib/components/board/board-utils.ts` - Status classes, column distribution logic
- `/lib/components/board/ActiveFleetRow.svelte` - Agent status display
- `/lib/components/board/BoardSkeleton.svelte` - Loading state

### Shared Components:
- `/lib/components/TaskList.svelte` - Task table for list view
- `/lib/components/TaskFilters.svelte` - Filter UI (status, type, automation, tags, etc.)
- `/lib/components/ItemDetail.svelte` - Spec item detail panel
- `/lib/components/ItemTree.svelte` - Spec tree visualization
- `/lib/components/ReferenceLink.svelte` - Reusable reference display/link component

### UI Component Library:
- `/lib/components/ui/` - shadcn/ui components (Dialog, Sheet, Badge, Button, Textarea, etc.)

---

## 5. KEY DIFFERENCES SUMMARY

| **Additional Content** | VCS refs, Plan ref, Session ref, Dependencies, Blocked By | Dependencies, Blocked By | Acceptance Criteria, Traits, Linked tasks |
| **Static Mode Handling** | Hides all write actions | Disables with tooltip on Start button | N/A |
| **WebSocket Reloading** | Yes (onTaskUpdated callback) | Yes (updates both list and panel) | Yes (reloads on item change) |

---

## 6. TYPE DEFINITIONS

### TaskSummary (List View):
```typescript
{
  _ulid: string
  slugs: string[]
  title: string
  type: string
  status: string
  priority: number
  spec_ref?: string
  tags: string[]
  depends_on: string[]
  automation?: string
  created_at: string
  started_at?: string
  notes_count: number
  todos_count?: number
}
```

### TaskDetail (Full Detail):
```typescript
// Extends TaskSummary with:
{
  description?: string
  derivation?: string
  blocked_by: string[]
  context: string[]
  vcs_refs: string[]
  plan_ref?: string
  session_ref?: string
  notes: Note[]          // Full Note objects
  todos?: Todo[]         // Full Todo objects
}
```

### ItemDetail (Spec Detail):
```typescript
{
  _ulid: string
  slugs: string[]
  title: string
  type: string
  tags: string[]
  acceptance_criteria: AcceptanceCriterion[]  // With test coverage indicator
  traits: string[]       // Trait references
  depends_on: string[]
  priority?: number
  description?: string
  parent?: string
  created_at: string
}
```

---

## 7. SHARED UTILITIES & PATTERNS

### ReferenceLink Component:
- Used consistently for task/spec/plan/session references
- Normalizes `@` prefix
- Shows title with short ULID fallback
- Supports `inline` mode for nested interactive elements
- Supports `stopPropagation` for click handling

### Color/Status Utilities:
- `getStatusClasses()` from `board-utils.ts` - Returns `{ bg, fg, label }` for each status
- Used by TaskCard, TaskDetailModal, and TaskList
- Design system tokens: `bg-status-{status}`, `text-status-{status}-fg`

### API Functions:
- `fetchTask(ref)` - Get TaskDetail
- `fetchTasks(params)` - Get paginated TaskSummary[]
- `fetchItem(ref)` - Get ItemDetail
- `fetchItemTasks(ref)` - Get TaskSummary[] linked to item
- `startTask()`, `submitTask()`, `completeTask()`, `blockTask()`, `addTaskNote()`

---

This comprehensive analysis shows that the web UI uses three distinct approaches to task/spec detail viewing, each optimized for its context (Kanban workflow, list filtering, or spec hierarchy navigation).
